tldr: On Oct 5, coverage of Nvidia-backed Reflection AI said it was preparing an open-source model, pitched as a DeepSeek of the West. By Oct 6 the model, Beam, was out.
whats_new: Reflection AI released Beam on Oct 6, a 501B-parameter open model with 23B active (501B-A23B), positioned against low-cost Chinese models like DeepSeek and Kimi.
why_it_matters: It is a large open-weight option from a US lab, which matters if procurement or policy rules out Chinese-origin models.

beats.headline: Nvidia-backed Reflection preps an open model, framed as a DeepSeek of the West
Beam (501B-A23B) released as an American open model
Coverage turns to Beam's competitive position against Chinese models

open_questions: How does Beam score against DeepSeek and Kimi on independent evals?
What license and inference cost does Beam ship with?
take_for_builders: Add Beam to your open-weight eval shortlist and check its license and serving cost before comparing it with DeepSeek or Kimi in your harness.
